name: Qada' wa Qadar
overview: Set within the corridors of hospitals, the series explores the issue of medical errors in Yemen and the human suffering it inflicts on many families. Through the intertwined stories of characters inside a hospital, the narrative reveals attempts to cover up mistakes and highlights the struggle between seeking justice and confronting a complex system that stands in the way.
